items.title: Why Is Marriott International (MAR) Entering Hokkaido With Its First Westin Resort?
items.summary: Marriott International (NasdaqGS:MAR) has agreed a franchise deal for the new Westin Hokkaido Furano Resort with Pacifica Hotels, marking its first Westin Resort in Hokkaido, Japan. The partnership expands Marriott’s upscale footprint in the Asia Pacific region through a conversion project that targets international leisure travelers in a new Japanese destination. items.title: Is Marriott (MAR) Quietly Redefining Its Tech Moat With LG’s New In‑Room Platform?
items.summary: Marriott International recently announced that, working with LG Electronics, it has developed and begun piloting a cloud-based in-room entertainment and device-management platform across 40 hotels in the US and Canada as the first phase of a broader rollout.
